import httpx
from api_fetch import fetch_json


def open_ticket_titles(client: httpx.Client, project: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return all titles of open tickets for the given project, paginating through all pages."""
    titles = []
    params = {"status": "open", "project": project}
    url = "/tickets"
    while url is not None:
        data = fetch_json(client, url, params=params)
        titles.extend(item["title"] for item in data["items"])
        url = data.get("next")
    return titles

import httpx


def open_ticket_titles(client: httpx.Client, project: str) -> list[str]:
    titles = []
    status = "open"
    url = "/tickets"
    params = {"status": status, "project": project}

    while url is not None:
        response = client.get(url, params=params)
        response.raise_for_status()
        data = response.json()
        items = data.get("items", [])
        titles.extend(item.get("title") for item in items if "title" in item)
        next_url = data.get("next")
        if next_url is None:
            break
        # next_url is relative and must be requested with the same params again
        url = next_url
        params = {"status": status, "project": project}

    return titles

import httpx
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs, urlencode, urlunparse


def open_ticket_titles(client: httpx.Client, project: str) -> list[str]:
    titles = []
    # Initial request parameters
    params = {"status": "open", "project": project}
    url = "/tickets"

    while url is not None:
        # Send GET request with required query parameters
        response = client.get(url, params=params)
        response.raise_for_status()
        data = response.json()
        # Extract titles from items
        items = data.get("items", [])
        for item in items:
            title = item.get("title")
            if title is not None:
                titles.append(title)
        # Get next page URL or None
        next_url = data.get("next")
        if next_url is None:
            break
        # Parse next_url to extract query parameters
        parsed = urlparse(next_url)
        # Build base path for next request
        url = parsed.path
        # Extract query parameters from next_url
        next_qs = parse_qs(parsed.query)
        # Flatten query parameters (parse_qs returns values as lists)
        next_params = {k: v[0] for k, v in next_qs.items()}
        # Ensure required parameters status and project are included for next request
        next_params["status"] = "open"
        next_params["project"] = project
        params = next_params

    return titles
